name: FindPdfTextNode
label: Pdf Regex Contains
description: Checks if the Pdf contains text matching a regular expression pattern (case-sensitive).
author: @aventisia

fields.name: PdfFilePath
fields.label: Pdf File Path
fields.description: Full path to the Pdf file to search (e.g., C:\docs\document.pdf).

fields.name: RegexPattern
fields.label: Regex Pattern
fields.description: Regular expression to search for in the Pdf (e.g., "Name:\s*\w+"). Case-sensitive.

fields.name: TextFound
fields.label: Text Found
fields.description: True if the regex pattern matches any text in the Pdf; otherwise, false.
